				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain }

					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation }
				change_building_level_in_location = {

tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6001 }
	}
}

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }

	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6002 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_great_port_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6003 }
	}
}

			exists = capital

	}
}

tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6005 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_hydraulic_workshop_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6006 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mining_city_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6007 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_giant_observatory_clear_finalization_base_modifiers_effect = {
	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_1
	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_2
	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_3
	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_4
	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_5
	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_6
}

tv_wonder_giant_observatory_apply_finalization_base_modifier_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_1 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_2 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_3 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 4 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_4 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 5 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_5 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 6 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_giant_observatory_level_6 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }

			if = {
				limit = {

tv_wonder_giant_observatory_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_foundation }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_foundation
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}

tv_wonder_river_extension_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6013 }
	}
}

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }

		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country

			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6014 }
	}
}

			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country

			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}

	}
}

tv_wonder_giant_armory_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6017 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_library_of_nation_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6018 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_large_canal_system_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6019 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mountain_terrace_network_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6020 }
	}
}

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }

	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6021 }
	}
}

	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_level_3
	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_level_4

	remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_level_6
}

tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_apply_finalization_base_modifier_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_level_1 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_level_2 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_level_3 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 4 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_level_4 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }

tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_style_1_construct_final_building_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes

			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_grain_price_granaries }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }

				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_grain_price_granaries cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }

					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }

tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_foundation }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_foundation
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_body }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_body
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_function }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_function
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_decoration }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_granary_system_decoration
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
		}

	}
}

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6029 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_royal_art_district_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6030 }
	}
}

	}

	}

	}

	}

tv_wonder_grand_cathedral_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6042 }
	}
}

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6043 }
	}
}

		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }

				}
			}
			else_if = {

				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated value = 3 owner = prev }

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6123 }
	}
}

	}

tv_wonder_unique_suez_ancient_canal_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6129 }
	}
}

	}

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6138 }
	}
}

	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6140 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6149 }
	}
}

		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 150 }
		hidden_effect = {
			tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_clear_finalization_base_modifiers_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_clear_finalization_ceremony_modifiers_effect = yes
		}
		tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_apply_finalization_base_modifier_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_apply_finalization_ceremony_modifier_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_apply_finalization_visible_rewards_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_style_1_finalization_hidden_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 150 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 1 }
		hidden_effect = {
			tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_style_1_construct_final_building_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_complete_finalization_cleanup_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_cache_post_finalization_priority_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_clear_project_state_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
